lessons.root_cause: A private host-owned file is not readable by container UID 10001 under Docker rootless UID remapping.
lessons.prevention: Keep the key in a Boca-only volume and prove ownership, mode and actual UID 10001 read access before starting.

lessons.root_cause: A successful release run did not prove that the operator-supplied digest was the image scanned and published in that run.
lessons.prevention: Bind the exact digest, source SHA and first-attempt run ID to the uploaded release manifest before host credentials.

lessons.root_cause: A socket checked from UID 1000 could appear absent when it was merely inaccessible; staging capacity omitted the rootless image store.
lessons.prevention: Inspect from the dedicated UID and check both staging and validated DockerRootDir capacity before any Boca mutation.

lessons.root_cause: Configured Compose and HostConfig limits did not prove the running controller had only the Boca network, safe flags and effective rootless cgroup limits.
lessons.prevention: Inspect the attached network by exact ID, require Boca Compose labels and no foreign peers, verify security metadata, and read effective cgroup v2 limits with a fixed in-container probe before PASS.

lessons.root_cause: Initial capacity could pass before an image pull consumed rootless Docker headroom, so key creation and startup were not gated by the post-pull reserve.
lessons.prevention: Measure staging and verified Docker storage after pull and before key, then again before PASS; reject changed backend, directory or filesystem identity.

lessons.root_cause: Two fresh manual release dispatches for one SHA both had attempt 1 and could serially repush the mutable SHA tag.
lessons.prevention: Require only the current first-attempt run in bounded workflow history before build and again before registry login.

lessons.root_cause: The host workflow used deployment readiness before distinguishing read-only inspection from installation, so enabling observation also unlocked the initial install gate.
lessons.prevention: Require an independent read-only environment marker and execute the first-step operation matrix before checkout or SSH, retaining a separate deployment marker for installation.

lessons.root_cause: OpenSSH joined locally quoted command arguments into a remote shell string, losing the empty image positional argument before the host parser.
lessons.prevention: Serialize read-only remote commands with shlex.join and execute actual workflow steps through a local remote-shell transport regression.

lessons.root_cause: An absent dedicated rootless socket did not distinguish unavailable Docker executables from a missing, inactive or failed user service.
lessons.prevention: Inspect fixed executable availability and allowlisted user-service properties without daemon operations; require the dedicated identity and a proven private bus before contacting systemd.

lessons.root_cause: Unrelated pull requests and manual host operations shared a GitHub concurrency group, allowing newer pending work to replace older validation even with cancel-in-progress disabled.
lessons.prevention: Separate validation groups by pull-request number, retain one constant manual host mutex, and reject changed routing, cancellation or deployment triggers in policy and regressions.

lessons.root_cause: Database.migrate enabled WAL and ran schema DDL before validating an existing migration checksum, altering rejected databases and adopting unversioned files.
lessons.prevention: Validate the existing ledger through mode=ro, then recheck checksum and file identity through mode=rw before application DDL/WAL/chmod; reject unknown files and create fresh files exclusively.

lessons.root_cause: A double-slash anchor retained by pathlib did not match the single-slash traversal path, bypassing the candidate directory ownership and writable-mode check in a review candidate.
lessons.prevention: Require single-root absolute candidate and anchor paths, reject double-slash account homes, and keep descriptor-based no-symlink traversal with explicit ownership checks.

lessons.root_cause: The read-only local status projection enumerated schema versions only through 6 and capped ledger reads at 7, so reviewed Telegram migration 7 caused a false availability failure.
lessons.prevention: Validate each installed reviewed migration by exact checksum and set the bounded ledger query to the number of recognized versions plus one, rejecting future versions and corruption.

lessons.root_cause: The panel discarded the durable host's canonical command ID after member/event deduplication and redirected to the newly submitted operation UUID, which had no detail row.
lessons.prevention: Validate and retain the returned canonical UUID for the redirect and its replay; fail closed without a Location header if the host result has no valid command ID.

lessons.root_cause: The stop-test inventory allowlist predated the optional Telegram service, so a future valid worker would prevent Boca test shutdown as an unknown container.
lessons.prevention: Require complete inventory validation and prove the worker's fixed Compose identity, command, UID, immutable Boca image digest, local image ID and revision before any stop.

lessons.root_cause: The Site owner-volume custody preflight filtered only Boca-labeled and Boca-named containers, allowing a foreign container in the dedicated rootless daemon to remain invisible before pull or sealed bootstrap effects.
lessons.prevention: Require an empty full rootless daemon container inventory before pull, after pull, before owner directory preparation, immediately before the sealed Site helper and before reporting PASS; preserve all resources on uncertainty.

lessons.root_cause: The tablet-local owner ceremony requested residentKey preferred without a platform authenticator, so enrollment could accept a device-bound nondiscoverable credential instead of a key stored by the tablet credential manager.
lessons.prevention: Require a platform authenticator and discoverable credential with user verification in the served creation options, and explain that browser cookies hold only temporary panel sessions.
